## board failed-run decide

Decide a failed run’s card

Retries the run, hands the issue to a person or cancels; the issue’s owner or someone who may edit it decides, once.

```bash
nb-studio board failed-run decide <run> --action <string>
```

| Argument | Description         |
| -------- | ------------------- |
| `run`    | The run identifier. |

| Flag       | Type                        | Description                       |
| ---------- | --------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| `--action` | retry \| reassign \| cancel | The decision to apply. (required) |
| `--user`   | string                      | The user identifier.              |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/failedRuns/{runId}/decide` (`failedRunsDecide`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio board failed-run decide 42 --action retry
nb-studio board failed-run decide 42 --action reassign --user bob
```

## board get

Get the Agent queue

The issues agents are involved in that the caller may see, by section, with the issue list’s filters.

```bash
nb-studio board get
```

| Flag         | Type   | Description                |
| ------------ | ------ | -------------------------- |
| `--q`        | string | Text to search for.        |
| `--project`  | string | The project identifier.    |
| `--label`    | string | The label identifier.      |
| `--owner`    | string | The owner user identifier. |
| `--executor` | string | The executor identifier.   |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/agentBoard` (`agentBoardGetBoard`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio board get --project 12
```

## board issue-work

Get current agent work on visible issues

At most 100 issue IDs. Only visible issues with an agent executor are returned. No run details are exposed.

```bash
nb-studio board issue-work --issue-ids <string[]>
```

| Flag          | Type     | Description                                                                       |
| ------------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--issue-ids` | string[] | The issue identifiers whose agent work should be returned. (required; repeatable) |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/agentBoard/issueWork` (`agentBoardIssueWork`)

## board start

Start the agent’s work on an idle issue

Needs a caller who sees the issue and may edit issues; nothing starts in backlog or while the issue waits for others (`skipped`).

```bash
nb-studio board start <issue>
```

| Argument | Description           |
| -------- | --------------------- |
| `issue`  | The issue identifier. |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/agentBoard/issues/{issueId}/start` (`agentBoardStartIssue`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio board start PM-12
```
